data.gender_notes: Athish is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Athish is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Athi', which means 'Lord of Gods'. In Hindu mythology, Athish is a divine being and the ruler of the universe. This name is believed to bestow strength, courage, and wisdom upon the bearer. The name Athish carries the meaning “Lord of Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Athish usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Athish belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Athish total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
